correctness.rationale: Complete derangement-face enumeration (99, 734, 6335, 61984 nonempty faces), verified acyclic element matchings (47, 350, 3039, 29904 pairs) and critical vectors exactly (one vertex, respectively 4 1-cells, 33 2-cells, 256 3-cells, 2175 4-cells) rigorously produce the integral wedge equivalences for n=4..7. The Hasse-DAG checker separately proves no directed cycle over every incidence. Signed Lefschetz characters were verified by two exact parity computations and conjugacy-class averages. Hall extension lemma proved for all n>=3; no beyond-seven homotopy inference.

value.rationale: An exact homotopy classification for the four consecutive first positive-dimensional members of the natural crown/bipartite-double-cover family, including a 2175-sphere four-dimensional wedge hiding inside a pure six-dimensional complex, and the full rational 30-value automorphism homology character with a nonzero invariant line. Exact full-face and orientation records are not trivial numerical restatements of derangement counts. It supplies reproducible benchmarks for the general perfect-matching-complex problem and natural symmetry computations; no conjectural all-n formula is asserted.
